question: Should maintainers accept this focused iMessage sanitizer hook now, or pause it in favor of a shared outbound sanitizer default for the remaining umbrella work?
rationale: The patch is a narrow, tested iMessage fix, but it intentionally changes delivered message text and CI cannot prove every legitimate prose case that might resemble an internal trace line.

options.title: Land Focused iMessage Slice
options.body: Accept the limited suppression risk because the patch matches merged sibling-channel fixes, preserves ordinary prose in tests and proof, and leaves the umbrella issue open for other channels.

options.title: Pause For Shared Default
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want one central outbound sanitizer policy before more per-channel hooks land.
